reply.text:
Good on you for bringing him in. At 11, the focus is learning to move well and enjoying it, not loading weight. Start with bodyweight and light loads, simple patterns like squats, pushes, pulls and carries, and keep the reps clean with plenty of room left in the tank. Technique first, and let him see you take your warm-up seriously.

Because he's a growing kid, I'd have a pediatrician or a qualified youth coach set his actual plan. If you want something built for your own training that he can tag along with, tell me what you're working on and I'll have the engine build it.
